name: fpl-hsmem
description: ForgePlan Hindsight memory plugin for Claude Code. v3.4.0: NEW RETRIEVAL-AND-MEMORY.md — the reference for which question goes to which layer. It corrects a rule this plugin itself shipped two releases ago: "never ask code search why" is WRONG, because ADRs, RFCs and PRDs are files in the repository, found by the same tools and outranking memory. The boundary separates THREE layers (sources -> recorded decisions -> memory), and recorded decisions are asked FIRST. Also corrected from live re-measurement: an index-backed search yields false NEGATIVES when stale (an empty result is not proof of absence, and the exit code is indistinguishable from an honest one); an AST tool misapplied to a literal is recognised by a confident SMALL NUMBER (192 files vs 4 measured), not by slowness, and an invalid pattern exits 0 with nothing. Every timing in the document carries its repository, query shape and date — a timing without provenance is folklore, and two conclusions of the policy this generalises did not survive re-measurement. 27 MCP tools, 3 hooks, 9 skills, 1 curator agent.
